finding: Python 3.14.7 is the current stable release shown; Python 3.15 remains pre-release before its planned October 2026 release.
application_decision: Day96 executed on the available Python 3.11.5 interpreter; no 3.12+ execution claim.

finding: tiktoken 0.14.0 was released 2026-08-17 and requires Python >=3.9.
application_decision: Research candidate only; Day96 uses no tiktoken runtime and makes no model-token-count claim.

finding: Encoding behavior depends on the selected encoding and explicit allowed/disallowed special-token policy; encode_batch supports concurrent calls.
application_decision: A future real Adapter must pin encoding and special-token policy and test Unicode, determinism, and concurrency. Current classroom execution proves none of those tiktoken properties.

finding: The loader may read cached encoding data or fetch it through requests when absent; cache path and hash verification are relevant to offline operation.
application_decision: Do not assume first-use offline behavior. A future deployment must prepackage and verify encoding data; the classroom tokenizer requires no network.

finding: langchain-text-splitters 1.1.2 was released 2026-04-16 and requires Python >=3.10.
application_decision: Research candidate only; no framework dependency was introduced.

finding: The API exposes chunk size, overlap, a length function, optional start index, and whitespace stripping. Start index is off by default.
application_decision: This does not itself prove complete Day95 lineage, multiple exact source segments, normalization maps, boundary evidence, stable identity, or Committer authority. Keep any future splitter behind an Adapter and validate its candidate.

finding: Documented SentenceSplitter and code/sentence-window parsers; SemanticSplitterNodeParser compares sentence embeddings and its example uses OpenAIEmbedding. This page is versioned older documentation, not a current package-version claim.
application_decision: Embedding-based semantic chunking is conceptual/NOT RUN in Day96; no Day98 dependency or Provider call was made.

finding: Unicode 18.0 text segmentation specifies grapheme, word, and sentence boundaries, with language-specific tailoring and ambiguity in punctuation.
application_decision: The simple Day96 punctuation heuristic is a classroom policy, not UAX #29 or multilingual sentence segmentation conformance.

finding: Distinct metric attribute combinations drive SDK aggregation state and cardinality cost.
application_decision: No tenant, document, chunk, request, or raw-content values are proposed as default metric labels.

finding: Sensitive span, log, and metric attributes need filtering, redaction, deletion, or hashing controls.
application_decision: Evidence and classroom reports contain contracts, hashes, safe reasons, and aggregate metrics, not raw source text or secrets.
